post1.quote: Commercial mining threatens habitats that cannot be replaced on human timescales.

post2.quote: We don’t accept an ocean stripped of life as the price of progress.

post3.quote: We will not wait for irreversible damage before demanding action.

paragraph.quote: We cannot recover an extinct species

raw.note_quote: the prediction that mining will cause hundreds of extinctions is not established and shouldn’t be presented as certain.
